target: Retail Wii 4.x shell; 4.3 U/E behavior baseline

coordinates.origin: Top left of the fitted Wii frame, not the browser viewport
coordinates.scaling: One unit = fitted frame height / 480 CSS pixels
coordinates.note: 854 is a rounded capture width. Native 608/832 × 456 projection and VI output are separate coordinate spaces; see research.json.

curve.note: Scale stays holder height / 398 in both modes, including the 399-unit wide holder. Clip and stroke share one path.

clock.fontStatus: OFL M PLUS subset approximates Rodin; segmented time glyphs are recreated SVG artwork.
clock.localizationNote: J/K hour/period positions follow native policy; date and AM/PM words still use the existing English fallback, not native localized labels.

anchors.rule: width = columns × cardWidth + (columns − 1) × columnGap; left = (frameWidth − width) / 2 + gridInsetCorrection; page stride = columns × (cardWidth + columnGap)
anchors.note: Logical slot rectangles differ from masked visible borders. A slot begins at x=69 at 854×480; its visible border begins near x=71.

anchors.rule: edge = holderHeight − depth × holderHeight / scaleHeight; horizontal fractions use measured holder width
anchors.note: Fitted reconstruction, not original BRLYT pane data.

anchors.rule: Clock top and date bottom are frame anchors. A blank leading hour cell preserves subsequent pane positions.
anchors.note: Approximate glyph artwork; firmware of bare reference menu images remains unknown.

anchors.rule: Footer is bottom-anchored; calendar transition transforms retain their own rules.
anchors.note: Mail-pulse and SD-insertion appearance still differ from some native states.

anchors.rule: center fraction = (416 − 245) / 832; left = sdCenterPercent% − sdWidth / 2 × scale
anchors.note: CSS percentage is rounded to 20.5529 to preserve the tested implementation.

evidence.confidence: Implementation values are fitted approximations. Bare menu captures do not identify exact firmware; the Settings reference alone prints 4.3U.

profiles.note: 4.3 U/E behavior evidence and 4.0+ style captures; partial J/K behavior with English labels.
